PAIRED_SUPPORT_VALID.notes: One-to-one keys, identical y_true and target dates, and identical availability were asserted for every support before any loss was aggregated; the principal support is fixed across p.

TRAIN_ONLY_VALID.notes: mu_hat and gamma_hat for every origin are estimated on observations ending 1 day(s) before the origin date; the lag vector at the origin is information available at the origin, exactly like persistence.

NO_ORACLE_SELECTION.notes: Models come from a declared fixed list; select_evaluated_models raises if evaluated losses are passed in. No best-model envelope row exists.

MISSINGNESS_TESTS_PASS.notes: The complete daily calendar is preserved, gaps are never dropped before lag construction, and the compressed-time estimator is reported only as a labelled sensitivity.

P_SENSITIVITY_COMPLETED.notes: p in [7, 14, 21] evaluated on the fixed global support and on order-specific supports, with case counts on both.

BLOCK_BOOTSTRAP_COMPLETED.notes: Block lengths [7, 14, 21] over origin vectors, 2000 replicates, seed 20260806. No length is marked primary.

SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION_COMPLETED.notes: White noise, AR(1), AR(q), nonlinear, incomplete-calendar, identity and bootstrap-pairing scenarios all executed under a fixed seed.

RESULT_REPLICATES_ACROSS_MORE_THAN_ONE_S.notes: A complete, identity-verified decomposition with bootstrap intervals was produced on the principal support for 3 stations: ['Elche', 'Valencia Vivers', 'Zarra EMEP']. This condition records mechanical availability across stations only; whether the substantive pattern replicates is part of NON_TRIVIAL_INTERPRETATION_FOUND.

NON_TRIVIAL_INTERPRETATION_FOUND.notes: Scientific judgement reserved to the human reviewer. This pipeline cannot declare P2_PAPER_GO.

_summary.rule: NON_TRIVIAL_INTERPRETATION_FOUND is a human scientific judgement. P2_PAPER_GO cannot be declared by this pipeline under any combination of mechanical results.
